COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.301 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, learned counsel 
for the revisionist. 
2. Mr. Vijay Khanduri, learned Brief Holder 
for the State.
3. Present revision has been filed by the 
revisionist challenging the judgment and order 
dated 29.04.2025 passed by learned Third 
Additional Sessions Judge, Rudrapur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar in Criminal Appeal No.153 
of 2023, Mahendra Singh @ Mohinder Singh vs. 
State of Uttarakhand and Another for the offence 
punishable under Section 138 of Negotiable 
Instrument Act as well as the judgment and 
order dated 16.08.2023 passed by learned 
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Senior 
Civil Judge Rudrapur, District Udham Singh 
Nagar in Criminal Complaint Case No.2637 of 
2016 Hardayal Singh vs. Mahendra Singh @ 
Mohinder Singh. 
4. As per office report service regarding 
respondent no.2 is found to be sufficient. 
5. Admit. 
6. Let the objection be filed by the 
respondents within three weeks.
7. List on 05.01.2026.
8. As an interim measure till the next date of 
listing effect and operation of the impugned 
order dated 29.04.2025 passed by learned Third 
Additional Sessions Judge, Rudrapur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar in Criminal Appeal No.153 
of 2023, Mahendra Singh @ Mohinder Singh vs. 
State of Uttarakhand and Another as well as the 
judgment and order dated 16.08.2023 passed by  learned Additional Chief Judicial 
Magistrate/Senior Civil Judge Rudrapur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar in Criminal Complaint 
Case No.2637 of 2016 Hardayal Singh vs. 
Mahendra Singh @ Mohinder Singh shall 
remain stayed. 
9. Interim relief application stands disposed 
of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 12.11.2025
